title: SEO blog post for a local service business
prompt: Write an educational blog post for Brightline Heating titled around the question 'Why is my furnace making noise?' aimed at North Valley homeowners searching that phrase. Requirements: an SEO title of 60 characters or fewer and a meta description of 155 characters or fewer, both labeled; body of 1,200 to 1,600 words; at least four descriptive H2 sections including one on when to call a professional; distinguish noises a homeowner can safely observe from situations needing a licensed professional or emergency response; close with a call to action for the $95 furnace diagnostic visit. Safety rules: never instruct the reader to open, bypass, or repair gas or electrical components, and do not promise any response time.

completion.check: A labeled SEO title of 60 characters or fewer and a labeled meta description of 155 characters or fewer are both present.
The body has at least four descriptive H2 sections, including one about when to call a professional.
The post closes with a call to action for the $95 furnace diagnostic visit.
The body is roughly 1,200-1,600 words; use the measured word count (the measurement includes title/meta/headings, so allow about 1,150-1,800 total).

skill_adherence.check: Nothing instructs the reader to open, bypass, or repair gas or electrical components; dangerous signs (e.g. gas smell) route to shutting off at accessible user controls, leaving, or calling emergency/professional help.
No response-time promises, invented statistics, certifications, review counts, or customer stories; the only price used is the $95 diagnostic.

best_practices.check: The post actually answers the query: it names distinguishable furnace noises and their likely causes rather than generic filler.
A reader can tell which situations are safe to observe versus which require a professional or emergency response.
